business_description.value: Nexora Technology is classified in the semiconductor industry. Its main businesses are defense and aerospace control, communication modules, a semiconductor chip design verification platform (EDA), fintech, and other products and services.
business_description.quote: Main business: 國防航太控制、通訊模組、半導體晶片設計驗證平台(EDA)、金融科技及其他產品服務
